metadata.description: First footage of A Guardian Rises past the Wall: entering The Breach, finding and picking up the starter rifle, Fight Through the Wall starting, and the first Fallen attack ending in Guardian Down and a respawn. Game audio only; scripted controller input.
metadata.previous_state: Until today The Breach stayed dark with its barrier closed, no rifle dropped, the Guardian started with a hand cannon, and no enemies spawned.
metadata.current_state: The Breach lights and opens, the rifle drops and is picked up as the first weapon, the objective moves to Fight Through the Wall, and Fallen spawn and attack.
metadata.remaining_issue: The rifle arrives without ammunition; firing is not shown in these clips; the route and objectives past The Breach are not served yet; menu icons stay loading spinners; this run rendered at 1280x720 internally (clips are upscaled to 1080p).
metadata.next_task: Map the route from The Breach to the graveyard and serve the next objectives with their Fallen encounters; load the rifle on pickup and record it firing.
metadata.recording_notes: Window capture of the game image only (no title bar, cursor or desktop); audio from the emulator output, no microphone. Clips are stream-copied from the original recording, not re-encoded. Internal display setting 1280x720 for this run.
